image_description: A close-up, macro shot of a European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra). The image focuses on the head and upper torso, displaying the characteristic glossy black skin with large, irregular yellow patches. The eye is visible, appearing dark and protruding. The skin texture appears wet and glandular. A portion of a forelimb is visible in the lower left, showing black coloration with small white/yellow speckles.
